target_claims.statement: For positive viscosity, rapidly decreasing divergence-free initial data, every unforced Leray-Hopf solution on R3 has finite L4_t L6_x mixed norm on every finite positive time interval.
The L4_t L6_x mixed norm is invariant under the three-dimensional Navier-Stokes scaling with the transformed time interval stated exactly.
Lambda in L2_t implies finiteness of the critical L4_t L6_x integral.

inputs: Explicit imported axioms for Leray-Hopf solutions, mixed-norm finiteness, and the positive Clay whole-space alternative.
checker_contract.acceptance: Elaborate the exact quantifier order and time-first exponent pair, report the three imported analytic axioms, and preserve CriticalIntegrabilityImpliesClay as an unproved one-way proposition.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject hidden analytic assumptions, toy substitutes, interval or exponent drift, a reverse Clay implication, or any claim that NS-CI-T-000, NS-A2, or global regularity is proved.

claim_boundary: This ready packet supplies a canonical target interface with explicit imported axioms. It does not prove universal critical integrability, NS-A2, the continuation bridge, or global Navier-Stokes regularity.
blockers: The one-way critical-integrability-to-Clay bridge remains an unproved proposition.
The imported analytic predicates require later formalization or an accepted theory-interface disposition.
reopening_conditions: Reopen when the target quantifiers, exponent order, imported axiom boundary, continuation bridge, A2 evidence, or MATHCERT disposition changes.
